title: triticum tauschii
intro: Triticum tauschii, commonly known as Dukou or Tausch's wheat, is a wild relative of wheat and belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Triticum tauschii include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating pain, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents present in Triticum tauschii are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer activities.
